newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Applied Materials, KLA, PRI.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Applied Materials, KLA, PRI.

text.p: Hambrecht & Quist said its analyst Gus Richard has cut his stock rating to hold from buy for three makers of semiconductor equipment: Applied Materials Inc, KLA-Tencor Corp and Pri Automation Inc.
-- "We recommend that investors take profits in the group going into the summer," Richard said in a statement.
-- He said he sees a good June quarter, but expects "order momentum for equipment companies to slow starting in the second half of 1997."
-- He said valuations for all three companies are near highs and "risk/reward for a majority of the group is unfavorable."
